outcome: Probability of having a second child
Probability of having a third child
cohort: 771,690 women in Sweden who delivered their first singleton infant between 1992 and 2010
finding: Compared to spontaneous vaginal delivery, vacuum extraction was associated with a lower probability of subsequent childbirth, and this was further reduced for emergency or elective caesarean section.
mod_finding: A first delivery by vacuum extraction was associated with a lower probability of subsequent childbearing, but not to the same extent as a first delivery by emergency or elective caesarean section.
